Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity

Class Entity

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rewindable, Collidable, Updatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Character, ItemDrop, Projectile, Shopkeeper, TeleportZone, Wall
public abstract class Entity extends Object implements Updatable, Collidable, Rewindable
Anything that lives in the world and is updated once per logic tick (GDD 1.3.1).

Pattern: Template Method. update(long) is final and calls onUpdate(long), the step each subclass fills in.

    • writeState

      public void writeState(StateBuffer out)
      Writes the part of the R photo every entity has: its position and whether it is removed. The size of the body never changes, so it is not saved. A subclass calls this first.
      Specified by:
      writeState in interface Rewindable
      Parameters:
      out - the photo being taken
